title: Terraform module: VPC observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL, Vector)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reusable Terraform module to deploy a minimal production-grade observability stack into customer VPCs for Private deployments. The module should provision Prometheus (via Helm), Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and Vector for log shipping. It must support configurable placement (EKS namespace vs ECS), provide health checks and endpoint outputs, follow semantic versioning, and include an upgrade/rollout plan that avoids data loss and reduces service disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Module published to internal registry (registry.redwood-internal/observability) with v0.1.0
Module exposes inputs for cluster id, namespace, node selectors, storage class, and prometheus retention
Helm releases for Prometheus and Grafana successfully deploy to a test VPC (EKS) via pipeline
OTEL Collector configured to forward traces and metrics to hosted Redwood endpoints and optionally to customer OTLP endpoints
Vector configured to ship logs to customer's S3/Elasticsearch/Redwood-log-endpoints with batching & backpressure
Automated healthcheck resources (k8s deployment/helm hooks or cloudwatch alarms) created and outputs exposed
Upgrade tested: minor and patch upgrades perform zero-downtime Helm upgrade in staging; major-version upgrade documented with migration steps
implementation_notes: Module shape: root module that wires together three submodules: prometheus, grafana, otel-collector, and an optional vector/logship submodule. Prefer helm_release resources for k8s components (helm provider + chart versions pinned). Support two deployment modes via a 'platform' variable: 'eks' (default) and 'external' (for cases where observability is deployed outside customer cluster but within VPC). Use TLS for internal endpoints and create k8s service objects with readiness/liveness probes. Provide outputs: prometheus_endpoint, grafana_endpoint, otel_collector_endpoint, vector_metrics_endpoint. Store persistent volumes using PVCs and allow optional ephemeral mode for customers that opt out of PVs.
terraform_module_interface: Inputs: cluster_name, kubeconfig (path or data source), namespace, platform, prometheus_chart_version, grafana_chart_version, prometheus_retention_days, pv_enabled, storage_class, vector_destination (s3|es|redwood), otel_exporters (redwood|customer_otlp), enable_rbac. Outputs: prometheus_endpoint, grafana_endpoint, otel_collector_endpoint, vector_config_secret_arn, healthcheck_urls.
upgrade_strategy: Pin chart versions and default to conservative minor updates. Provide a 'chart_version_override' variable to force upgrades. For Helm chart upgrades use helm_release with 'wait = true' and max history = 10. For major schema changes (e.g., moving from Prometheus Operator vX to vY) add migration scripts in docs and a terraform plan step that creates a temporary scrape-target proxy to avoid gaps. Document statefulset PVC migration steps and recommended snapshot/backup (Velero or AWS EBS snapshots) before major upgrades.
testing_plan: 1) Unit: terraform validate + fmt + terratest / kitchen-terraform smoke test that creates minimal namespace and verifies helm releases are installed. 2) Integration: run in isolated staging VPC EKS cluster; verify metrics ingestion (prometheus remote_write -> staging backend), dashboards load, OTEL traces appear in staging tracing backend, and logs arrive at vector destination. 3) Upgrade tests: apply v0.1.0 -> v0.1.1 and simulate pod restarts; run major upgrade dry-run and confirm documented migration steps.
rollout_plan: Ship as v0.1.0 in internal registry. For existing private customers, enable opt-in migration with 'observability_module_enabled' flag in their infra repo. For new customers default to enabled. Use canary rollout: target 2 low-risk customers first, run extended monitors (48h), then push to remaining customers. Provide rollback commands and a quick-runbook for the SOC/OPS team.
security_notes: All components must use customer-managed KMS for secrets where available. Grafana default admin password must be generated and stored in customer secrets manager; default public dashboards disabled. OTEL collector configuration must not forward PII by default; add scrubbing processors and document how to configure filters. Vector should have backoff and bounded queue sizes to avoid OOM during bursts.
